correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives the exact balance dF/dt=-a x^2+(1/2)(dz/dt)^2, and an exact symbolic check gives zero residual. The bounded-orbit and periodic-orbit identities follow by integration. The compact invariant-measure identity follows from the generator balance. For a<=0, the largest invariant subset of the zero-derivative set consists only of equilibria; LaSalle invariance on a bounded forward orbit and connectedness of its omega-limit set then give convergence to a single equilibrium. The Shimizu-Morioka companion identity is verified in the same symbolic artifact.

originality.rationale: The checked literature covers the original Rucklidge convection model, global Shimizu-Morioka dynamics, Hopf/local bifurcation work, Darboux and meromorphic integrability, the scaling equivalence, unstable periodic-orbit organization, and invariant algebraic manifolds. No inspected statement gives the exact balance, its invariant-measure form, or the nonpositive-damping bounded-recurrence barrier. The 2023 invariant-algebraic-manifold paper was available only at abstract/bibliographic level and is recorded as the principal residual risk.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact parameter-only L2 diagnostic for every non-equilibrium periodic orbit, a necessary sign condition for every compact non-equilibrium invariant probability measure, and a global convergence theorem for every bounded forward orbit when a<=0. It also resolves a concrete inconsistency in the literature by ruling out a bounded recurrent attractor at the published example (a,b)=(-0.1,-1).
